title: Washio Sumi
overview: Divine Era, year 298, two years before "Yuuki Yuuna's Chapter", Washio Sumi who was chosen by Shinju-sama, is a hero who protects the world alongside her classmates, Nogi Sonoko and Minowa Gin. It seems like Sonoko and Gin are trouble-makers because they could be idiotic or too energetic. Sumi is excited that she should lead the other two, but...

title: Friends
overview: The WaSuYus haven't been able to unify because they haven't had much time to prepare. So, they decided to choose a leader and strengthen their unity by doing a training camp. Sumi saw herself as the leader, but Aki-sensei appointed Sonoko as the leader...

title: Daily Life
overview: The WaSuYus now have stronger unity, are working hard to fulfill their roles as heroes. It's part of their job to rest as well. Three of them started to fully enjoy their momentary break.

title: Spirit
overview: The WaSuYus are going to their elementary school's class trip. The three of them are put in a crisis because of the Vertex's advanced action whom appeared as if to shatter their fun daily life.

title: Goodbye
overview: The Hero's system advances to prepare for the battle with the escalating enemy. However, that was too brutal for the girls in 6th grade to have to bear. Nevertheless, the girls work hard to fulfill their roles.

title: Promise
overview: Finally, the climactic battle has begun. The heroes are fulfilling their roles with full of new powers. The flowers bloomed beautifully. What kind of destiny would await them in the future...
